import sys, openpyxl

in_path = sys.argv[1]
out_path = sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Read all data
rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws.max_row, max_col=ws.max_column, values_only=True):
    rows.append(list(row))

# Find last occurrence of each unique value in column B (index 1)
last_occurrence = {}
for i, row in enumerate(rows):
    val = row[1]
    last_occurrence[val] = i

# Collect kept rows in order
kept_rows = [rows[i] for i in sorted(last_occurrence.values())]

# Write kept rows starting at row 1
for r_idx, row_data in enumerate(kept_rows):
    for c_idx, val in enumerate(row_data):
        ws.cell(row=r_idx + 1, column=c_idx + 1, value=val)

# Clear remaining rows (from len(kept_rows)+1 to original max_row)
for r_idx in range(len(kept_rows) + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
    for c_idx in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        ws.cell(row=r_idx, column=c_idx, value=None)

wb.save(out_path)
print(f"Done. Kept {len(kept_rows)} rows, cleared rows {len(kept_rows)+1} to {ws.max_row}")
